# Color By Feliks

> A creative entrepreneurship platform teaching artists how to build sustainable, profitable businesses through social media and audience engagement.

Color By Feliks specializes in helping visual artists and creators monetize their work by leveraging social media marketing, content creation, and business strategy. The platform's flagship offering is The Freedom To Create™ course, which combines practical business education with creative empowerment.

## Key Topics

- The Freedom To Create™
- Artist Monetization
- Social Media Marketing
- Creative Entrepreneurship
- Audience Building
- Content Creation
- Online Art Business
- Artist Business Strategy
- Creative Income Streams
- Visual Artist Education

## Flagship Courses

- [The Freedom To Create™: Master Social Media to Transform Your Art into a Thriving Business](https://learn.colorbyfeliks.com/freedomtocreate): Comprehensive course teaching artists to monetize via social media and build sustainable creative businesses through audience engagement and strategic content creation
